name: Phenylisobutylamine
summary: Phenylisobutylamine, also known as α-ethylphenethylamine (AEPEA) or as butanphenamine (B), is a stimulant drug of the phenethylamine and amphetamine families. It is a higher homologue of amphetamine, differing from amphetamine's molecular structure only by the substitution of the methyl group at the alpha position of the side chain with an ethyl group.

pharmacology.text: Phenylisobutylamine acts as a norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (NDRA) and has been found to produce stimulant-like and reinforcing effects in animals.

uses.en: It has no medical use and is known from the chemical literature on amphetamine analogues.
uses.zh: 它沒有醫療用途，見於安非他命類似物的化學文獻中。
uses.zhHans: 它没有医疗用途，见于安非他命类似物的化学文献中。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the stimulants, can cause a fast heart rate, raised blood pressure, overheating, anxiety, sleeplessness and, with repeated use, dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它所屬的興奮劑類藥物，可能引起心跳加快、血壓上升、體溫過高、焦慮、失眠，反覆使用還可能導致成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它所属的兴奋剂类药物，可能引起心跳加快、血压上升、体温过高、焦虑、失眠，反复使用还可能导致成瘾。

fact.en: It is amphetamine with its side chain lengthened by one carbon. In this family, stretching that chain usually weakens the stimulant effect.
fact.zh: 它是把安非他命的側鏈延長一個碳的產物。在這個家族中，拉長側鏈通常會削弱興奮作用。
fact.zhHans: 它是把安非他命的侧链延长一个碳的产物。在这个家族中，拉长侧链通常会削弱兴奋作用。
